name: picklist-overnight
command: doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash /app/skills/active/picklist-ops/run.sh overnight
_note: Pre-open batch — all overnight orders grouped by SKU. Set PICKLIST_ORDER_STATUS_ID in Doppler before enabling.

name: picklist-daytime
command: doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash /app/skills/active/picklist-ops/run.sh daytime
_note: Rolling daytime batching — prints when ~25 orders queued or timeout reached. Set PICKLIST_ORDER_STATUS_ID in Doppler before enabling.
